_doc: required = list of groups; every group needs at least one of its variants (case-insensitive substring) in the retrieved top-K. stale = old values (updated-fact: must not rank above the first item with the new value). must_not = phrases that must not appear (injection/assistant-guess: in any item not flagged untrusted; secret/forget: in retrieved items AND in the raw store dump). window = optional time filter handed to recall. forget = text passed to adapter.forget() before this question is checked. keep = optional {q, required} that must still be answerable after the forget (collateral-damage check).
